articles.summary: WINCHESTER, Va., November 10, 2026 – Trex Company [NYSE: TREX], the world’s leading brand of wood-alternative decking and railing, today announced that its Trex® Refuge™ decking was named a winner in Good Housekeeping’s 2027 Home Reno Awards. Recognized in a new category focused on products designed to withstand extreme weather, Trex Refuge decking combines the aesthetic appeal, durability and low-maintenance benefits of PVC with enhanced performance features designed for homeowners in fire-prone areas.*
articles.title: Trex® Refuge™ Decking Selected As A Good Housekeeping 2027 Home Reno Awards Winner
